provider_reference_policy.cost_control: Submit one user-product image and one integrated scene hint only. Do not split the mug, dessert, magazine, tabletop or lighting into additional provider images.

transfer_scope: Basque cheesecake, warm-white plate and fork arrangement
partially cropped BAUHAUS magazine design and placement
clean plain warm-neutral white matte tabletop finish without marble-like material pattern
relative scene layout, scale, perspective and contact-shadow behavior

container_transfer_by_mode.preserve_source: Do not transfer the reference mug. Preserve only the user's broad container family, transparent material, rim and simple structural design under the preset overhead camera.
container_transfer_by_mode.adopt_reference: Transfer the plain white glazed-ceramic mug design and handle direction from the integrated scene hint.

excluded_transfer: reference coffee, crema, latte art, bubbles and beverage recipe
exact environmental shadow silhouette and pixel layout
hint_images.reason: Provider reference input for adopt-reference mode. It supplies the declared mug and companion-scene design while the user image remains the sole beverage-identity authority.

dessert_group.plate: one modest warm-white to off-white matte ceramic dessert plate with a shallow raised rim, subtle handmade irregularity and a soft physically attached contact shadow

cheesecake.type: one triangular slice of Basque burnt cheesecake
cheesecake.geometry: most of the triangular top is visible; the center is gently sunken while the irregular outer curved edge is slightly higher; retain only a narrow physically plausible cut sidewall
cheesecake.top: thin irregular deeply caramelized dark-brown skin with amber variation, subtle ripples and creases; never a flat uniform orange plane or fully black surface
cheesecake.middle: thick pale ivory to light custard-yellow cream-cheese center, dense yet tender, moist, finely porous and softly crumbly; never sponge, castella, chiffon, pound cake or bread crumb
cheesecake.base: thin distinctly darker golden-brown baked biscuit or crust band

dessert_group.fork: one slim realistic four-tine stainless-steel dessert fork across the lower half of the plate below the cake; tines point left, handle extends right almost horizontally with a slight upward rise; it does not touch or cover the cake

magazine_group.anchor: far right edge at approximately 2-3 o'clock
magazine_group.appearance: only a peripheral cropped portion of the same white BAUHAUS magazine, with bold black BAUHAUS typography, gray architectural cover graphic and visible white book edge or spine
magazine_group.priority: secondary peripheral prop that never competes with the beverage or dessert

preserve: broad source container family and material
source cup saucer or support plate when visibly paired with the cup
source spoon design when visibly paired with the cup or its saucer
discard: source camera pose and rim ellipse
exact source height, taper and sidewall geometry
sidewall branding that is not naturally visible from overhead

source_serviceware_contract.identity_scope: preserve source design, material, color, count and cup-relative arrangement while adapting only the projection to the preset overhead camera
source_serviceware_contract.absence_rule: do not invent a saucer, plate or spoon when it is absent from the user source
source_serviceware_contract.reference_exclusion: never replace source serviceware with serviceware from the integrated scene hint

preserve_source.prompt_addendum: Rebuild a simple container in the same broad source family and material under the preset camera. When the source cup is visibly paired with a cup saucer or support plate and spoon, preserve their design, material, color, count and cup-relative arrangement while adapting their projection to the overhead camera. Do not invent missing serviceware. Exact source height, taper, sidewall geometry, decoration and branding are not invariants. Never tilt or rotate the container to reveal branding; omit sidewall branding when it is not naturally visible and invent no replacement.

discard: source camera pose and rim ellipse
adopt_reference.prompt_addendum: Use the versioned compact plain white glazed-ceramic mug. Keep beverage color, syrup, fruit, ice and foam strictly inside the inner rim. Keep the complete exterior and base clean plain white ceramic with no colored stain, band, transparency or beverage layer.

camera_contract.projection: rectilinear overhead with slight real perspective

4:5.prompt_addendum: Generate the exact final 4:5 canvas. Keep one complete primary overhead beverage, including the full adopted handle, 0.27-0.34 of frame width and 0.17-0.22 of frame height, centered around x=0.55-0.60 and y=0.58-0.63. The product bbox applies only to the primary beverage. Add exactly the declared dessert group above it and the cropped magazine at the far right edge. Preserve 0.55-0.70 meaningful table-and-floor negative space, a right-dominant round table occupying 0.66-0.82 of the frame, and a narrow left gray tiled-floor wedge with receding grout.

1:1.prompt_addendum: Generate the exact final 1:1 square canvas from the start; do not crop a portrait composition. Keep one complete primary overhead beverage, including the full adopted handle, 0.25-0.32 of frame width and 0.20-0.27 of frame height, centered around x=0.54-0.60 and y=0.56-0.63. The product bbox applies only to the primary beverage. Recompose exactly the declared dessert group above it and the cropped magazine at the far right edge for the square canvas. Preserve 0.48-0.64 meaningful table-and-floor negative space, the right-dominant round table and a narrow left gray tiled-floor wedge with receding grout.

hard_fail: output inherits the oblique source camera
cup rim is strongly elliptical or too much sidewall is visible
beverage, syrup or fruit appears on an opaque container exterior or base
round table edge or left gray floor wedge disappears
floor grout does not recede or the table reads as a flat background
broad off-frame environmental shadow atmosphere is absent
fabric, coaster, napkin or an undeclared decorative prop appears; a source saucer, support plate or spoon is allowed only in preserve_source mode when visibly present in the user image
the cheesecake reads as castella, sponge, bread or a flat uniform cake
the fork tines do not point left or the handle does not extend right below the cake
the declared BAUHAUS magazine is missing, enlarged, relocated or replaced with a different design
the tabletop has marble veining, cloudy mottling, faux-stone patches, plaster texture, repeated procedural noise or synthetic render smoothness
reference coffee, crema or latte art replaces the user's beverage, or the exact reference shadow silhouette leaks
